card.name: Everyday idioms in casual web text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words inside everyday idioms and sentences in general web text, such as 'matter' in 'a matter of time' or 'street' in 'word on the street'.

modes.label: Idiom words
modes.description: Words partway through a set phrase in casual writing, just before the phrase finishes.
modes.example: It’s just a<< matter>> of time.

card.plain: It reacts to scattered words in everyday phrases, with no pattern a clinician could use.
